candidate.user_submission: Dis pikin na 24 months old. E dey get diarrhoea for 3 days now. E no dey vomit everything. E never convulse and e no dey convulse now. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. For how e dey drink, e dey drink poorly. E no get blood for stool. E eye dey sunken. Skin pinch normal. E no dey restless or irritable. For here cholera dey for area. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E no get ear problem. E no get fever.
